note: Cloth Config 11.1.136 is the 1.20.1 build folded into AppleSkin's META-INF/jars. Three kinds of breakage: (1) ConfigBuilderImpl.<init> reads Screen.field_44669 (1.20.1's OPTIONS_BACKGROUND_TEXTURE) which 1.21.1 deleted, so every config screen dies with NoSuchFieldError before it exists; (2) TextFieldWidget gained a shiftKeyPressed flag on setCursorToStart/setCursor, so Cloth's text-field cell ctor throws NoSuchMethodError; (3) the jar also needs the generic render-widget-override rule (12 method_25394 overrides that became final) - that one lives in render-widget-override.json and build.py passes both files.

callSiteAdaptations.evidence: NoSuchMethodError 'void net.minecraft.class_342.method_1870()' from AbstractTextFieldListListEntry$AbstractTextFieldListCell.<init>(AbstractTextFieldListListEntry.java:87) while ClothConfigScreen was being built; 1.21.1 has method_1870(Z)V (yarn setCursorToStart(boolean)), and the old body only moved the cursor, so false is the same behaviour.

Same class of change: 1.20.1 setCursor(int) is 1.21.1 setCursor(int, boolean). Found by runs/p210-cloth-config/scan_refs.py, which lists the whole constant-pool gap instead of surfacing one member per client launch; this call site is in the same text-field cell and was not reached separately because the ctor died one call earlier.
